map.基于关键路径法（CPM）自动计算工期、总时差与关键路径，并绘制甘特图。: Automatically compute duration, total float and critical path by the Critical Path Method (CPM), and draw a Gantt chart.
map.📖 查看「施工工序工期排程 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Construction Process Scheduling
map.紧前工序为空表示开工即开始；可设置多个工序同一紧前工序以实现并行作业。: Empty predecessor means start at project start; multiple processes can share the same predecessor to enable parallel work.
map.采用关键路径法：最早开始 ES = 紧前工序最早完成；最晚开始 LS 由后向推算: Using the Critical Path Method: earliest start ES = earliest finish of predecessor; latest start LS is back-calculated; total float = LS − ES, float 0 means critical process
map.关键路径（所有时差为 0 的工序连线）决定项目总工期，任何关键工序延误都会拖延竣: The critical path (all processes with zero float linked) determines total project duration; any critical-process delay postpones completion
map.标准模板为常规家装工序参考工期，实际应结合工程量与班组人数调整: The standard template gives reference durations for common home decoration processes; adjust by workload and crew size in practice
map.家装全流程排程：录入拆改→水电→泥瓦→木工→油漆→安装各工序工期与先后依赖，求出: Whole-process home scheduling: enter demolition→plumbing→masonry→carpentry→painting→installation durations and dependencies to find the critical path and total duration.
map.并行工序优化：识别非关键工序总时差，在不影响总工期下灵活插入定制家具等待等空闲。: Parallel-process optimization: identify non-critical total float and flexibly insert idle waits like custom-furniture lead time without affecting total duration.
map.延期影响评估：某工序延期时，看是否落在关键路径上，判断对交付日的影响。: Delay-impact assessment: when a process is delayed, check whether it lies on the critical path to judge the impact on the delivery date.
map.示例：拆改 3d→水电 7d→泥瓦 10d→木工 8d→油漆 6d（串行）。\n: Example: demolition 3d → plumbing 7d → masonry 10d → carpentry 8d → painting 6d (serial).
map.决定总工期的最长工序链，任一环节延期都会推后交付；非关键链有浮动时间。: The longest process chain that decides total duration; any link delay postpones delivery; non-critical chains have float time.
map.用「前置工序→本工序」表达先后，如水电必须在泥瓦前完成；并行用无依赖表示。: Express order as predecessor → this process, e.g. plumbing must finish before masonry; parallel is shown by no dependency.
map.结果能当合同工期吗？: Can the result be used as the contract duration?
map.本工具按输入估算理想工期，不含天气/返工/待料等风险，实际需留缓冲并签约定。: This tool estimates an ideal duration from input, excluding risks like weather/rework/material wait; allow a buffer and agree by contract in practice.
map.面向家装与小型工程的项目排程工具，内置标准工序模板，运用关键路径法自动计算工期、: A project-scheduling tool for home decoration and small works, with built-in standard process templates, using the Critical Path Method to auto-compute duration, float and critical path, visualized as a Gantt chart.
